map.：判断 97 是否为素数：只需试除到 √97≈9.8，即 2,3,5,7。均不能: To check whether 97 is prime you only need trial division to sqrt(97) = about 9.8, that is 2, 3, 5, 7. None divides evenly, so 97 is prime. 1 is not prime, and 2 is the smallest prime and the only even prime.

map.为什么试除只要到 √n？: Why Does Trial Division Only Go to sqrt(n)?
map.若 n 有因子 a×b=n 且 a≤b，则 a≤√n；一旦超过 √n 还没找到因: If n has a factor pair a x b = n with a <= b, then a <= sqrt(n); once you pass sqrt(n) without finding a factor, any larger factor must pair with a smaller one already tried, so it can never appear again. Therefore trial division to sqrt(n) is enough.
map.不是。素数定义为恰有两个正因子（1 和自身）的数；1 只有一个正因子，被排除在素: No. A prime is defined as a number with exactly two positive factors (1 and itself); 1 has only one positive factor and is therefore excluded, which is the convention of the modern definition.
